SELECT A.DID_ID AS didId, A.DID_NM AS didNm, A.DID_MAC AS didMac, A.DID_IPADDR AS didIpaddr, A.DID_SWVER AS didSwver, A.CENTER_ID AS centerId, A.DID_TYPE AS didType, A.DID_RESOLUTION AS didResolution, A.DID_WIDTH AS didWidth, A.DID_HEIGHT AS didHeight, A.DID_IPTYPE AS didIptype, A.DID_MODELTYPE AS didModelType, A.DID_USEYN AS didUseYn, TO_CHAR(A.DID_ENDCONTIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS didEndContime, A.DID_ENDTIME AS didEndTime, A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AS frstRegistPnttm, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID AS frstRegisterId, A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM AS lastRegistPnttm, A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID AS lastRegisterId, A.DID_REMARK AS didRemark, A.ROLE_CODE AS roleCode, A.DID_STTUS AS didSttus, A.DID_OS AS didOs, A.DID_SERIALTYPE AS didSerialtype, A.DID_SERIALPORT AS didSerialport, A.DID_MONITERCNT AS didMonitercnt, A.DID_STAETTIME AS didStartTime, A.DID_TIMEINTERVAL AS didTimeInterval, A.DID_SERIALJAVASCRIPT AS didSerialjavascript, B.GROUP_NM AS groupNm, B.GROUP_CODE AS groupId FROM TB_DIDINFO A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT D.DID_ID, E.GROUP_NM, E.GROUP_CODE FROM TB_GROUPDID D JOIN TB_GROUP E ON D.GROUP_CODE = E.GROUP_CODE ) B ON A.DID_ID = B.DID_ID WHERE A.DID_ID = #{didId}
